jobs.description: Help shape how the world discovers Prime Video's biggest titles — drive K-content marketing strategy across SEA while delivering global tentpole campaigns in Australia and New Zealand. We're looking for a Sr. Content Marketing Manager to join the Prime Video Content Marketing team, covering Southeast Asia (SEA) and Australia/New Zealand (AUNZ). This dual-remit role combines two exciting mandates: advancing the worldwide marketing approach for K-drama content and executing tentpole title launches across AUNZ. What makes this role exciting: - K-content (SEA & WW influence): Drive the marketing strategy for K-drama title launches across SEA, contributing directly to the worldwide K-drama marketing playbook. We've made meaningful headway, but there's significant runway ahead — you'll help evolve processes to tap into existing K-drama fan communities, and partner with Korean content partners in the KR entertainment industry. - Global tentpoles (AUNZ): Deliver end-to-end campaigns for Prime Video's biggest titles launching in Australia and New Zealand — from strategy through execution across multiple tentpole moments each year. - Work at the intersection of global content strategy and local market execution - Help establish scalable frameworks and share learnings that shape how Prime Video markets content worldwide Key job responsibilities - Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns for K-drama title launches across SEA markets - Build fan community engagement strategies to drive awareness, conversation, and viewership for K-content - Partner with KR content partners on assets, talent, and promotional activation - Plan and deliver tentpole title campaigns across AUNZ, working cross-functionally with social, creative, media, and product teams - Run experiments and contribute to measurement frameworks that inform worldwide content marketing strategy - Surface regional insights and performance data to influence WW marketing strategy for K-dramas - Understand K-drama content and fan-dom, the audience and develop a sense for the right marketing angle for each title. - Similarly, understand the AU & NZ audience, which Global titles would work and what the right marketing angle should be. Ingest signals that would inform decisions This is an individual contributor role within the Prime Video SEA & AUNZ Content Marketing team. A day in the life No two days look the same in this role, but here's a snapshot of what a typical week might involve: Morning: Review overnight performance data for a K-drama that launched last week. Pull together insights on social buzz and fan community reactions to share with the WW K-content marketing team. Jump on a call with the KR content partner to align on multiple topics including asset delivery, embargo dates and talent availability for Prime Video's PR & Marketing day. Mid-morning: Join a cross-functional sync with the AUNZ team to finalize the campaign plan for an upcoming global tentpole launching next month — aligning on media strategy, creative assets, and go-to-market timing with social, PR, and media partners. Afternoon: Work on a test-and-learn proposal for a new fan community engagement tactic — identifying the right K-drama fandoms to activate, drafting the experiment framework, and building a brief for the social team. Later, review creative assets coming in from the agency for an AUNZ title launch and provide feedback. Late afternoon: Prep a campaign recap deck for a recent AUNZ tentpole, capturing results, learnings, and recommendations to feed back into the global marketing playbook. End the day catching up on Slack threads with regional and WW stakeholders across multiple time zones. You'll regularly collaborate with: WW content marketing leads, KR content partners, regional social and creative teams, media agencies, PR, and product marketing. About the team Our team sits at the intersection of global content strategy and regional execution. We work closely with worldwide and APAC marketing leads, Korean content partners, creative and social teams, media agencies, and local stakeholders to deliver campaigns that resonate with diverse audiences across multiple markets. We value experimentation, fan-first thinking, and building scalable approaches that can influence content marketing globally.

jobs.description: The workspace is no longer just for humans. Enterprises are moving from traditional virtual desktops to intelligent, cloud-native environments where people and AI agents work side by side — governed by design, observable by default, and delivered anywhere. Amazon WorkSpaces is leading this transformation with WorkSpaces for Agents (now generally available), alongside WorkSpaces Personal, WorkSpaces Core, and WorkSpaces Applications. Together with services like AWS Context and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, we're building the operating environment for the next enterprise workforce — one where AI agents navigate applications, automate workflows, and build institutional knowledge inside trusted boundaries. The companies that lead won't just have the smartest AI — they'll build the most trustworthy place for intelligence to work. AWS is seeking a Worldwide (WW) GTM Specialist to accelerate adoption of Amazon WorkSpaces' AI and agentic capabilities. You will be part of a dedicated team focused on bringing these emerging solutions to market — defining the vision for agentic workspaces, building GTM motions around AI-enhanced features, and helping customers understand how governed cloud workspaces become the operating environment for their human + agent workforce. You'll be charting new territory at the intersection of end-user computing and enterprise AI — identifying early adopters, shaping lighthouse engagements, and building repeatable plays that scale. You are a strategic thinker who operates with urgency. You combine deep business acumen with enough technical depth to be credible with CIOs and IT leaders navigating the shift to agentic work. You understand that the hardest problem isn't teaching an agent to click — it's making sure those clicks happen inside an environment the organization can trust. You've built GTM strategies in emerging technology categories, rallied cross-functional teams around a shared vision, and delivered measurable business results. You're energized by ambiguity — because that's where the biggest opportunities live. Key job responsibilities - Define and execute the GTM strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces AI and agentic solutions — identifying high-value customer segments where agents can drive immediate productivity gains, and building programs that accelerate early adoption of WorkSpaces for Agents, AI-enhanced desktop experiences, and governed agentic environments. - Shape the narrative around the future of agentic workspaces — positioning AWS as the leader in trusted environments where humans and AI agents work together, with built-in governance, observability, and identity management that enable enterprises to scale autonomous work confidently. - Engage directly with enterprise leaders and partners to articulate how governed cloud workspaces solve the trust, security, and compliance challenges that keep agentic AI stuck in pilots — connecting agentic workspace capabilities to measurable business outcomes. - Build and scale lighthouse engagements with early adopters deploying AI agents in enterprise environments — generating compelling proof points around agent governance, productivity, and the human + agent operating model, then operationalizing those wins into repeatable plays. - Develop deep fluency in the WorkSpaces AI portfolio (WorkSpaces for Agents, integration with AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AWS Continuum) to articulate how the pieces fit together for customers across industries. - Establish data-driven mechanisms to measure adoption of agentic features, track program effectiveness, and continuously optimize the path from pilot to production-scale agent deployment. - Evangelize the agentic workspace vision externally through thought leadership, events, and industry engagement — and internally across AWS to drive mindshare and investment in this emerging category. - Orchestrate field uptake of AI-focused sales plays, equipping the broader sales organization to identify and qualify agentic workspace opportunities and deliver value through repeatable mechanisms.

jobs.description: Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role. NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position. Key job responsibilities - Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability - Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS) - Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA) - Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA - Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment - Technical writing to support change management program - Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion - On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation - Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Physical Requirements: - Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations: - Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently - Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds - Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder - Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position - Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational. Essential Requirements: - Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed - Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational - Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs A day in the life This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

jobs.description: The Security and Loss Prevention Expert (SLP Expert) is a key leadership position within the Amazon Security and Loss Prevention (S&LP) team. This role leads the effort to efficiently and effectively provide End-to-End (E2E) S&LP services across all assigned operational business units. This position reports to the SLP Cluster Manager. Key job responsibilities * Identify vulnerabilities and conduct root cause analysis using data to define mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards. * Actively monitor and report outcome for systems and tools that generate data indicating site/region opportunities. * Manage confidential investigations and prepare prompt reports of theft, fraud, and workplace violence/critical incidents. * Utilize continuous improvement to drive process enhancements and increase efficiency. * Serve as department’s liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert keeping site leadership informed on department’s key issues, strategies and the performance. * Identify, promote and implement security best practices while effectively partnering with internal customers to evaluate current and future security needs, processes, and initiatives, incident response planning, facilitating and management. * Domestic regional travel up to 50% of the time when applicable. * Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs). * This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays. A day in the life As a SLP Expert, you will join a team of S&LP professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you will collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in various processes to identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. jobs.description: Application deadline: Sep 30, 2026 Amazon Customs & Trade (ACT) manages US import customs clearance across multiple U.S. ports of entry for both internal and external Amazon customers. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential; cases routinely carry same-day response requirements with seizure, penalty, or mounting demurrage as direct financial consequence of inaction. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

조직 소개
본 직무는 Coupang Ads 조직의 프론트엔드(프런트엔드) 개발자로서 쿠팡 광고 플랫폼의 새로운 기능을 개발 및 설계하는 역할을 수행하게 됩니다. 쿠팡은 세계 최고 수준의 광고 비즈니스를 구축하기 위한 투자를 하고 있으며, 쿠팡 웹사이트 및 모바일 앱 상에 위치한 주요 구좌에 연관성 있는 광고를 운영하고 있습니다. Coupang Ads 조직은 쿠팡의 판매자 및 공급자에게 셀프서비스 광고 운영 기능을 제공함으로써 쿠팡의 광고 솔루션을 보다 성장시키기 위한 차세대 프로덕트 및 서비스를 개발 중에 있습니다.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/. The Mission — Why This Programme, Why Now? You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before. The architectural decisions being made now — how we structure networking, implement security controls, and automate at scale — will shape how Australia's national security community operates for the next decade. Your Role in the Story Imagine being the person who keeps one of the world's largest and most critical information system infrastructures running at peak performance. As a Data Centre Technician, you'll be the hands-on expert who ensures the physical backbone of the cloud never misses a beat. Every server you deploy, every cable you run, every issue you troubleshoot directly enables Australia's national security community to operate with confidence. This isn't just maintenance — it's mission-critical stewardship. You'll apply deep knowledge of computer architecture and the OSI model to solve complex, real-world problems that most engineers only read about. Your troubleshooting instincts will span server hardware, fibre optics, networking, and beyond. When something goes wrong at 2am, you'll be the calm, capable expert the team relies on. You'll serve as the escalation point for all systems issues — the person teams turn to when problems get complex. Your Linux expertise will be your superpower as you deep dive into server-level challenges that others can't crack. Leading Through Complexity During high-severity incidents, you'll be the technical point of contact — coordinating response, communicating clearly, and driving resolution. You'll meet 24x7 on-call requirements during shift rotations, knowing that your vigilance directly protects national capability. Physical Excellence You'll work confidently with equipment up to 20 kg, navigate cramped spaces and elevated locations, and do it all within rigorous health and safety guidelines. This is infrastructure work at its most tangible and rewarding.

About the Team
The Outside Account Management team at DoorDash partners with restaurant merchants to help them grow simply and profitable on the platform. Our mission is to support merchants throughout their journey – ensuring a positive experience while also helping them unlock meaningful growth opportunities. We work closely with merchants to understand their goals, solve operational challenges, and recommend growth strategies that fit their business – balancing thoughtful partnership with commercial impact.
About the Role
As a Senior Strategic Partner Manager, you will manage a more complex and higher-value portfolio of merchants, often including larger or more strategic accounts. You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, bringing a consultative, strategic lens to each partnership. In addition to core account management responsibilities, you will proactively identify growth levers, influence merchant decision-making, and drive adoption of advanced DoorDash products and solutions.
Senior SPMs are also expected to demonstrate leadership within the team—mentoring junior SPMs, sharing best practices, and contributing to broader team initiatives. You’ll take ownership of more sophisticated business challenges, navigate ambiguity, and partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver impactful outcomes. This role typically requires deeper experience in account management, sales, or partnerships, along with a strong track record of driving revenue growth and retention.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own and grow a portfolio of top SMB restaurant partners regionally, consistently meeting or exceeding revenue and retention targets
Lead strategic quarterly business reviews, translating performance data into clear insights, growth opportunities, and actionable plans
Proactively mitigate churn by identifying risks early and driving adoption of DoorDash products and solutions that unlock incremental growth
Leverage data and AI tools to diagnose operational inefficiencies, test improvements, and optimize merchant performance on an ongoing basis
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Operations, and Sales to advocate for merchant needs and deliver a best-in-class platform experience
Influence and navigate senior and C-suite stakeholders through compelling, data-driven storytelling and strong objection handling
We’re excited about you because…
You have 5+ years of experience in account management, post-sales, customer success, or a related client-facing role
You empathize with customer needs and adapt to meet their unique goals resulting in an increase in customer satisfaction, retention, and product adoption
You are a thoughtful, merchant first thinker who creates data-driven recommendations and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)
You maintain a strong bias for action and an ability to operate as an owner for your book of business
You use AI as a core part of your account management workflow by prioritizing opportunities, personalizing recommendations, improving efficiency, and validating insights with sound judgment and business context.
You have knowledge of Google Suite, including Google Slides (creating client-facing decks) and Google Sheets (can maintain complex spreadsheets)
You navigate sales and AI tools with ease (Salesforce, Outreach, Sales Navigator, Google Apps)
You manage a book of business, with experience with higher complexity small- to medium-sized business (SMB) clients, or Enterprise clients
Spanish speaking is a plus!

jobs.description: The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale. We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization. As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations. You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base. - Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. - Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions. - Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices. - Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability. About the team The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.
